meta.title: Charisma Test
meta.description: A detailed 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of charisma.

levels.label: Magnetic
levels.desc: You draw people in effortlessly — your presence, warmth, and confidence combine into a rare, natural magnetism that people remember long after you leave the room.

levels.label: Charismatic
levels.desc: You connect with people easily and leave a strong impression in most situations. A few dimensions are still worth sharpening to make your presence even more consistent.

levels.label: Engaging
levels.desc: People generally enjoy being around you and find you easy to talk to, though your charisma may fade in certain high-pressure or unfamiliar settings.

levels.label: Developing
levels.desc: Your charisma shows up in some situations but not others — strong in a few dimensions, inconsistent in others. Deliberate practice could make a real difference.

levels.label: Reserved
levels.desc: You tend to hold back in social situations, which can make it harder for your genuine warmth and ideas to come through. Small, consistent changes can open this up.

levels.label: Needs Practice
levels.desc: Right now, social situations may feel draining or uncomfortable rather than energizing. This is a good starting point for building charisma skills step by step.
